description: Read a WarmInboxes guide, study, playbook, dataset, recipe, comparison or changelog entry in full, as markdown. Long pages come in parts split at headings: the first call says how many, and nextPart gives the one to ask for. Datasets also return their data as JSON. Use the url find_resources gave you.

part.description: Which part of a long page, from 1. Defaults to 1.

url.description: The page, as find_resources returned it, e.g. "https://warminboxes.com/research/inbox-placement-log". A path works too.

name: read_resource
title: Read a guide or study
